name: csoai-gspc-mcp
description: GSPC measurement MCP server — Council of AI. Measure AI systems through GSPC axes, verify signed measurement cards. Ed25519 signatures, free verify stays loginless. No certification, no accreditation — measurement only.

tools.name: measure
tools.description: Run a subject through GSPC measurement axes and return a signed measurement credential (NOT a certificate). Unmeasured axes stay UNMEASURED.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify a signed card: recompute content_id, check Ed25519 signature + time-anchor. Free, anonymous, no trust.

tools.name: jail-probe
tools.description: Submit a jail-break attempt against a model. Returns the verdict contract.
